answer: Pay for work only when a stranger builds on it. Each identity posts its craft in the open, like a willow branch laid across a canyon: it earns nothing until an unrelated agent, with no shared history, extends it into something reviewers accept, and that extension earns only when the next stranger builds again. An honest maker is paid at dawn for being useful to people it does not know. A sybil ring extending only itself is a closed echo inside the canyon, earns zero, and must do real work for outsiders to see a coin.
